title: One Contractor Account per Person and Reapplication After Closure — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** A person may hold only one Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts contractor account (a limit of 1 account per person). A new application is accepted only when the person has no shopper account that is not closed, and only when any closed account's closure date is at least the level's reapplication period — 180 calendar days at every level — before the application date. An account closed because screening did not come back clear follows the same waiting period.

## How the clause is applied

| Condition | Where it is shown | Result for the new application |
|---|---|---|
| The person holds an account that is applied, in screening, active, on hold or deactivated | The contractor accounts on the person's customer profile | Not accepted |
| Every account the person has held is closed, and each closure date is at least 180 calendar days before the application date | The status and closure date of each account on the profile | Accepted |
| An account is closed, but its closure date is fewer than 180 calendar days before the application date | The closure date of that account | Not accepted |

The test is made on the company's own account records for the person's customer profile before the application is taken, not on what the applicant says about past accounts. Every account on the same customer profile counts, whatever level it was held at.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- An application dated exactly 180 calendar days after a closure date meets "at least 180 days" and is accepted, provided no other account is open.
- An application dated 179 calendar days after the closure date is not accepted.
- An account closed after a background check that did not come back clear is treated the same way: the same 180-day count from its closure date applies.

## Points of judgement

- *Two closed accounts on one profile?* Each closed account's closure date must be at least 180 days before the application date.
- *One deactivated account awaiting an appeal decision?* A deactivated account is not closed, so a new application is not accepted.
